# Xprinter Windows SDK runtime

TruePOS uses `printer.sdk.dll` from the official Xprinter Windows SDK 2.0.4 package.

Source: https://www.xprintertech.com/windows-sdk-for-receipt-printer

Included runtime hashes:

- `x64/printer.sdk.dll`: `FB4FC83B1CC420188B0E50B44068FB71C315762D35C308A2A062EB626670FF4D`
- `win32/printer.sdk.dll`: `CE11304ACDED7F873680EC37FDD1334B906EF5EEF81D043A43B2DC3ACDCAD876`

The vendor archive does not include a separate license or redistribution notice, and the DLLs are not Authenticode-signed. The application publisher should confirm redistribution terms with Xprinter before distributing the installer outside its own organization.
